Cataloged as Patthana 4.2, it constitutes a section in the complex cross-classifications of the *Paṭṭhāna*, combining the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) with the cluster of dyads on roots (*hetugocchaka*) to analyze conditional relations [SuttaCentral].
